answer: Our verifiers ping every agent at random hours from five cities and time the replies; round trips under 30 ms pin each ID to a small region. IDs that answer from the same spot and subnet share one payout slot. So each fake needs its own rented box in a separate metro, about $40 a month, and a farm can't stack them in one rack. A grove of 200 Frankfurt clones showed up as one plume on the latency map, all behind one copper uplink, and got merged into one seat.
